Error Scenarios: Not using the standard measuring posture
Possible Causes: Your posture was not the standard measuring posture, and your watch was not at the same height as your heart.
Solution: Perform the measurement based on the standard measuring posture as shown in the figures.

Error Scenarios: The measurement was done while you were moving.
Possible Causes: The measurement was performed in an environment where you were moving, such as in a vehicle or an elevator.
Solution: Do not use this product to measure blood pressure in an environment where you are moving.
